h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Satara

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Satara

items.pText: Satara district runs from the dry plains around the city up to Mahabaleshwar and Panchgani, and Panchgani has long been known for its boarding schools. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to residential schools, day schools, housing societies and gardens across the district. Our factory in Vasai East is about 220 km away, and we deliver by road.

A boarding school uses its play area very differently from a day school. Children are on campus in the evenings and at weekends, so the equipment gets far more hours of use. Tell us how many students live on campus, their age range and the size of the ground. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, so the school can plan play areas near the hostels as well as the classrooms.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

near each hostel gives younger boarders somewhere to play after study hours. A larger
near the main ground suits group play at weekends.

Up on the plateau the monsoon is very heavy, and mist and damp last for months. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle this well, and rubber flooring on a drained base keeps the area usable between showers. Down in Satara city the rain is lighter and summers are warmer, so shade matters more. For a Maharashtra project, see

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 220 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you supply schools in Panchgani and Mahabaleshwar as well as Satara city?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road across Satara district, including the hill towns. Our installation team or a local dealer installs the equipment on site.

items.q: How do we keep equipment in good shape through a long, wet monsoon?
items.a: Use galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts, lay the play area on a drained base and wipe down slides and seats after heavy rain. Check bolts and footings once the monsoon ends.

items.q: What age groups do you design for?
items.a: We have equipment for toddlers right up to older primary children. Tell us the age range on your campus and we will suggest pieces for each group.
